territory.New_Caledonia: Japanese military control of main south/central military corridor; Vichy nominal sovereignty; peripheral residuals not a main field army

japan_naval_posture.carrier_force: Akagi/Kaga lost; Shokaku/Zuikaku/Hiryu/Soryu restored as four-fleet-carrier core by autumn, with training/reorganization ongoing after operations
japan_naval_posture.indian_ocean: submarine/cruiser pressure only; do not strip Pacific surface reserve
japan_naval_posture.shipbuilding: Taiho and Unryu/Amagi/Katsuragi continue; no Shinano emergency carrier conversion; tanker/kaibokan/repair capacity increased

base_sustainment.new_caledonia_return_cargo: 2000-4000 t/month Nov-Dec; planned 5000-8000 Q1 1943 and 7000-10000 spring-summer; nickel/chromite etc.

five_go.status: formally approved in principle for spring 1943; Phase III Sichuan entry conditional
five_go.force: north 10 divisions + Yichang 6 divisions; central reserve ~1 division
five_go.shipping_policy: use 8-11万 GRT assault shipping released from limited FS; reject new permanent 30万 GRT civil requisition; allow temporary 3-5万 GRT Jan-Feb peak borrowing

allied_state.United_States: logistically able to build Hawaii/Samoa/Fiji/NZ/Australia; still weak in carrier-backed offensive amphibious conversion. Wasp survives and is repairing/returning; Essex commissioned 1942-12-31 but not yet front-line. Surface fleet is stronger than historical because Guadalcanal surface attrition did not occur.
allied_state.Britain: Indomitable/Formidable lost; Hermes survives; Indian Ocean escort and modern-carrier reserve constrained. Victorious US loan tends to be delayed 2-3 months because historical Formidable backfill is unavailable.
allied_state.Europe_Africa: El Alamein, TORCH, Stalingrad broad outcomes not reversed by Indian Ocean interference; effect is lower RN/merchant reserve elasticity and small-to-medium Axis strategic relief.

shipping_scope_caveat: No authoritative fixed end-1942 total Japanese merchant GRT yet. Mixed-scope 6.30-6.38m GRT conversational estimate remains quarantined. Use ship-days, delivered cargo, released assault shipping and fixed-category ledgers until a single 500GRT+ (or other chosen) universe is rebuilt.

Check Wasp/Victorious/Essex/CVL clocks and any major Allied strategic operation before advancing.
